|quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Siphoning Trap''' is a [[spell]] that throws a [[trap]] that tethers to nearby enemies when activated. Tethered enemies are {{stl|Chilled}} and take [[cold damage|cold]] [[damage over time]]. The [[character]] [[regenerate]]s [[life]] and [[mana]] depending on the number of affected enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== {{il|Cluster Traps Support}} and {{il|Multiple Traps Support}} do not benefit Siphoning Trap as only one use of the skill is stored at a time. The reduced damage from the support gems is still inherited, however. Despite that, it is possible to have multiple instances of the skill active, as long as they don't tether to the same target. If that happens, the oldest skill instance will be immediately terminated. Unlike most [[damage over time]] effects with a [[duration]], Siphoning Trap does not credit the player with [[kill]]s. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Cold
